gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization Grade IV IDH wildtype glioblastoma or variants including gliosarcoma or IDH wildtype glioma with molecularly features of glioblastoma.

candidate_evidence.quote: One dose of nivolumab plus ipilimumab will be administered 14(±5) days before surgery.
Both nivolumab and ipilimumab are antibodies (types of human protein) that work to stop tumor cells from growing and multiplying by immunotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Be at first or second relapse. Note: Relapse is defined as progression following initial therapy (i.e., radiation ± chemotherapy).

flag.reason: Group C (registered as EXPERIMENTAL) receives placebo-nivolumab plus placebo-ipilimumab before surgery and serves as the placebo control for the neoadjuvant primary endpoint; all groups receive nivolumab plus ipilimumab after surgery.

role_evidence.quote: Group A receives nivolumab plus ipilimumab
-- Nivolumab plus ipilimumab every 3 weeks for 3 doses followed by nivolumab every 4 weeks

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-PD-1 monoclonal antibody (approved immune checkpoint inhibitor)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy: antibody that works to stop tumor cells from growing and multiplying by engaging the body's immune system (anti-PD-1).

role_evidence.quote: Group A receives nivolumab plus ipilimumab
After surgery, participants receive nivolumab in combination with ipilimumab every 3 weeks for 9 weeks and then nivolumab alone every 4 weeks.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-CTLA-4 monoclonal antibody (approved immune checkpoint inhibitor)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Immunotherapy: antibody that works to stop tumor cells from growing and multiplying by engaging the body's immune system (anti-CTLA-4).

role_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Nivolumab-Placebo: Intravenous (IV) solution that has no therapeutic effect, used as a control in testing investigational drug. One dose is received prior to surgery.
[DRUG] Ipilimumab-Placebo: Intravenous (IV) solution that has no therapeutic effect, used as a control in testing investigational drug. One dose is received prior to surgery.
Subjects also have the option of undergoing Zr-89 Crefmirlimab berdoxam PET scans.

flag.reason: Diagnostic imaging agent in an optional sub-study, not a registered intervention and without antitumour intent; no role category fits exactly, coded supportive. Not a candidate.

source_quote.quote: Tumor Infiltrating T Lymphocyte (TIL) Density: TIL density will be assessed and compared between the three arms using the Two-sample t-Test.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: Cell cycle-related genetic signature in tumour microenvironment (multiplex IHC)

source_quote.quote: Multiplex IHC staining will be performed on tumor tissue to evaluate the influence of the neoadjuvant administration on the cell cycle-related genetic signature within the tumor microenvironment of recurrent glioblastoma.

coder_notes: Randomised three-group neoadjuvant window trial in recurrent IDH-wildtype GBM; groups differ only in pre-operative nivolumab/ipilimumab vs placebo, and all receive nivolumab plus ipilimumab after surgery. Both checkpoint inhibitors coded experimental_combination. Placebos listed as control_comparator (active_moiety 'placebo') for transparency. Zr-89 crefmirlimab berdoxam (CD8 PET tracer, optional sub-study) listed as non-candidate. Bristol-Myers Squibb is a collaborator (industry by [CODE]); no text statement of drug supply.
